# Access reviews example

This example configures two access reviews: a recurring quarterly review of a group's membership, and a one-time review of Global Administrator role assignments.

**WARNING**: Access reviews require an Entra ID P2 or Governance license - this module silently skips creating them if the tenant doesn't have one.

> **Note**
>
> Access reviews can use complex MS Graph queries - to allow easier configuration, this module supplies templates for common use-cases. See [/templates/README.md](/templates/README.md) for more information.

```hcl
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.9, < 2.0"

  required_providers {
    msgraph = {
      source  = "microsoft/msgraph"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

provider "msgraph" {}

module "entra" {
  source = "../../" # Replace with correct module path

  tenant_id = "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"

  organization_configuration = {
    notification_email     = "jane.doe@contoso.com"
    language               = "en"
    default_usage_location = "US"
  }

  access_reviews = {
    # A recurring, quarterly review of who has access to the "Engineering" group, reviewed by the
    # group's own owners. Recommendations help reviewers decide, but nothing is auto-applied - an
    # admin must apply the collected decisions once each instance completes.
    engineering_group_review = {
      display_name              = "Engineering group membership review"
      description_for_reviewers = "Please confirm you still require access to the Engineering group."
      scope = {
        template      = "users_assigned_to_group" # Using the template to check _any_ user assigned to a group
        template_vars = { group_id = "22222222-3333-4444-5555-666666666666" }
      }
      settings = {
        mail_notifications_enabled         = true
        reminder_notifications_enabled     = true
        justification_required_on_approval = true
        instance_duration_in_days          = 14
        recommendations_enabled            = true
        recurrence = {
          pattern = {
            type     = "absoluteMonthly"
            interval = 3
          }
          range = {
            start_date = "2026-09-01"
          }
        }
      }
      reviewers = [{
        query = "/v1.0/groups/22222222-3333-4444-5555-666666666666/owners"
      }]
    }

    # A one-time review of everyone currently assigned the Global Administrator role, per
    # Microsoft's recommendation to periodically review highly privileged role assignments. Users
    # who don't complete the review (or aren't approved) are automatically removed from the role.
    global_administrator_role_review = {
      display_name              = "Global Administrator role assignment review"
      description_for_reviewers = "Please confirm you still require the Global Administrator role."
      description_for_admins    = "One-time review of Global Administrator role assignments."
      scope = {
        template      = "users_assigned_to_role" # local.directory_role_template_id["Global Administrator"]
        template_vars = { role_id = "62e90394-69f5-4237-9190-012177145e10" }
      }
      settings = {
        mail_notifications_enabled         = true
        justification_required_on_approval = true
        instance_duration_in_days          = 7
        default_decision_enabled           = true
        default_decision                   = "Deny" # Remove the role from anyone who doesn't complete the review
        apply_actions                      = "removeAccessApplyAction"
        auto_apply_decisions_enabled       = true
        recurrence = { # Make this a one-time review in September 2026
          range = {
            start_date = "2026-09-01"
            end_date   = "2026-09-30"
            type       = "endDate"
          }
        }
      }
      # Fall back to the "Security Team" group's members if a primary reviewer can't be
      # determined for a given principal.
      fallback_reviewers = [{
        query = "/v1.0/groups/33333333-4444-5555-6666-777777777777/transitiveMembers/microsoft.graph.user"
      }]
    }
  }
}
```
